study: Humphrey et al. 2018 (EEF) — Good Behaviour Game (GBG) behaviour-management PD, cluster RCT, reading
delivery_evidence: Teachers receive two days of initial in-person training plus one day of follow-up midway, with ongoing support via monthly on-site GBG coach visits (typically a classroom observation) by Mentor UK coaches (intervention description, p.~13-14).
test_alignment_evidence: Outcome is the Hodder Group Reading Test (HGRT), a commercially published standardized reading test (standardised on >13,000 pupils), not tailored to GBG (Measures p.21; Table 6 p.36).
curriculum_evidence: GBG is a universal behaviour-management system (rules, teams, monitoring, rewards) played during typical class activities; schools receive GBG manuals plus reward/display materials, but no academic content curriculum is adopted (What/materials section, p.~13).
outcome_timing_evidence: Primary reading outcome measured at T3 (summer 2017), the end of the two-year intervention (same period as intervention end); no post-treatment delayed follow-up extracted (Table 6 p.36; extraction timepoint=post).
